summary: Allow outage merge groups to finish without optional cache publication

rules.detail: No checkpoint or admission rules change.

compatibility.detail: No daemon, client or harness protocol changes.

downtime.detail: No service deployment or downtime introduced.

recovery.detail: Required checks and logs remain; disable the outage variable to restore optional cache saves.

manual.detail: CI_OUTAGE_FAST_QUEUE=on skips optional merge-group Nix saves and same-source build-snapshot publication only. Cache reads, shared keys, member eligibility, required checks and producer test archives remain unchanged. Set off at outage end; restore temporary ruleset max_entries_to_build from six to two.
